scripts.build: npm run build -w @nexora/shared && npm run build -w @nexora/backend && npm run build -w @nexora/frontend
scripts.build:backend: npm run build -w @nexora/shared && npm run build -w @nexora/backend
scripts.render:build: npm run build -w @nexora/shared && npm run build -w @nexora/backend
scripts.build:hosting: npm run build -w @nexora/shared && npm run build -w @nexora/frontend
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run build:hosting && firebase deploy --only hosting
